description: This file defines a React component module for a DataTable toolbar, including subcomponents for search, clear filters, and call-to-action buttons, with hooks for filtering and localization.

classes.name: DataTableToolbar
classes.description: A composite object containing subcomponents for the DataTable toolbar: Root, SearchBar, ClearFiltersButton, and CTA.

methods.name: SearchBarComponent
methods.description: A React component for a search input that syncs with the data table's search term.

methods.name: ClearFiltersButtonComponent
methods.description: A React component that renders a button to clear column filters if any are active.

methods.name: CTAComponent
methods.description: A React component for a customizable call-to-action button.
